items.title: Hologic signs agreement to acquire Reveal Genomics (HER2DX breast cancer test)
items.summary: Hologic has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Barcelona-based Reveal Genomics, maker of the HER2DX test for HER2-positive breast cancer, to complement its Breast Cancer Index test. Closing is subject to Spanish regulatory approval and customary conditions; price not disclosed in the release.

items.title: Publication of Pharmaceutical Technology and Pharmacology of Parenteral Oncology Drugs
items.summary: We are delighted to recognise the recent publication of Pharmaceutical Technology and Pharmacology of Parenteral Oncology Drugs, a new book bringing together expertise from oncology pharmacy professionals across the world.

items.title: Acute and Supportive Oncology Clinical Consensus Statement
items.summary: BOPA welcomes the Acute and Supportive Oncology Clinical Consensus Statement, to which we were pleased to contribute.

items.title: Women from marginalised groups waiting longer for breast cancer care
items.summary: Black patients and those with learning disabilities face longer waiting times for breast cancer care, a new nationwide study has found.

items.title: Holistic support of patients with breast cancer in primary care
items.summary: The impact of breast cancer is multi-faceted and can extend far beyond the period of active cancer treatment, affecting the person physically, psychologically, socially, economically and spiritually.

items.title: Six suppliers share £850m national chemotherapy medicines framework via HealthTrust Europe
items.summary: A new eight-year national framework for aseptically prepared systemic anti-cancer therapy medicines has gone live via HealthTrust Europe, hosted by Mid South Essex NHS Foundation Trust, with a combined value of up to £850 million.

items.title: Five AI tools approved for identifying prostate cancer on MRI scans
items.summary: Five artificial intelligence tools for more accurately detecting prostate cancer in MRI scans have been approved for use on the NHS. NICE said the tools have the potential to act like a ‘second pair of eyes’, helping radiologists review prostate MRI scans and improve accuracy and consistency of diagnosis.

items.title: NHSE reminds GPs of carcinogenic risk of some cancer treatments following patient death
items.summary: GPs should ‘be aware’ of the carcinogenic risk of some cancer treatments, NHS England has said following the death of a patient who had a rare radiation-induced cancer.

items.title: ITH Pharma and Baxter top South East's £8.6m dose-banded chemotherapy framework
items.summary: Berkshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust has awarded a ranked framework for dose-banded and patient-specific chemotherapy products on behalf of the South East Pharmacy Procurement Service, open to up to 26 trusts across Kent, Surrey, Sussex, Hampshire, Oxfordshire and the Thames Valley.

items.title: International Debate Webinar: Eastern and Western Medicine Can Co-exist – part of London Global Cancer Week 2026
items.summary: Monday 2 November 2026 | 21:00 GMT (check your local time) Part of London Global Cancer Week 2026 Can Eastern and Western medicine co-exist in modern cancer care?

items.title: Cervical cancer screening – a practical guide for nurses in primary care
items.summary: Lead nurse at The Eve Appeal charity Helen Hyndman explains the key principles and practical steps involved in the national cervical cancer screening programme, and how nurses in primary care can support with improving uptake. Read the full CPD module on Nursing in Practice 365 today.

items.title: Impact of staff training on body temperature measurements during cancer treatment: a single-site quality improvement project
items.summary: Background: Neutropenic sepsis is a serious complication of cancer therapy, and can often be detected by the presence of abnormal body temperature, typically fever. Aims: This research aimed to improve home temperature measurement in a cancer triage unit following a previous audit.

items.title: BOPA 2026 Mentioned in Pharmaceutical Journal
items.summary: Invest in aseptic services for future of specialised medicines, says chief pharmacist – The Pharmaceutical Journal Aseptic facilities are “absolutely essential” for hospitals to be involved in clinical trials…

items.title: Implementation and evaluation of a nurse-led clinic for men referred with suspected prostate cancer
items.summary: Background: Cancer diagnostic delays remain a challenge. Advanced nurse-led clinics represent an innovative approach to improving pathway efficiency while delivering person-centred care.

items.title: Nurse teams up with researchers on breast cancer drug study
items.summary: Find out more about a specialist nurse in Somerset who has teamed up with a team of researchers to help with a study on the side effects of a breast cancer medication.

items.title: GIRFT launches national radiotherapy workstream to cut 31-day treatment delays
items.summary: GIRFT has started a radiotherapy workstream supporting the 85% 62-day cancer target.
